prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Conservative Party Manifesto 2019 – Summary (ideological framing retained)

My Guarantee (with a Conservative majority):
- Pass our new Brexit deal immediately and leave the EU in January to unleash the country’s potential.
- Extra NHS funding: 50,000 more nurses and 50 million more GP appointments a year.
- 20,000 more police and tougher sentencing.
- Australian-style points-based immigration system.
- Major weekly investment in science, schools, apprenticeships and infrastructure while controlling debt.
- Net Zero by 2050 via clean energy and green infrastructure.
- No increase in the rates of income tax, VAT or National Insurance.
A Corbyn–SNP alliance means two referendums in 2020 and more chaos. Back a majority Conservative Government so Britain can move forward.

Get Brexit Done
- End three-and-a-half years of deadlock with our “oven‑ready” deal: out of the single market, customs union and ECJ; no political alignment; our laws, borders, money and trade policy under UK control.
- Start passing the deal before Christmas; leave in January; agree a free trade agreement in 2020 with no extension beyond December.
- Use post-Brexit freedoms for freeports, global trade deals, higher standards and targeted tax changes (e.g., abolish the tampon tax).

Unleash Britain’s Potential
- Responsible investment with strict fiscal rules; level up every region and support superb public services powered by a dynamic free market economy.
- NHS: record cash boost; 40 new hospitals and 20 upgrades; 50k nurses, 6k more GPs; 50m extra GP appointments; Innovative Medicines Fund; mental health parity; NHS visa; clamp down on health tourism; NHS not on the table in trade talks.
- Social care: extra £1bn every year; cross‑party long‑term reform; no one forced to sell their home to pay for care.
- Schools: £14bn extra; minimum per‑pupil funding; higher starting salaries; strong discipline and Ofsted; more free schools; arts premium; major SEN support.
- Work, families, cost of living: freeze main tax rates; raise NI threshold; raise National Living Wage to two‑thirds of median; expand childcare; keep pension triple lock; improve Universal Credit.
- Skills and opportunity: £3bn National Skills Fund; more apprenticeships; upgrade FE; UK Shared Prosperity Fund.

Law, Order and Fairness
- 20,000 more police; fair, proportionate stop‑and‑search; tasers/body cams; tougher sentences (end halfway release for serious crimes; whole-life for child murder); more prison places; national cyber crime force; Victims’ Law; Domestic Abuse Bill.

Controlled, Fair Immigration
- Points-based system prioritising skills and contribution; overall numbers down; equal treatment for EU and non‑EU; fast‑tracks for NHS and top scientists; contribution before benefits; right historic wrongs (Windrush).

Economy, Business, Infrastructure
- Cut and reform business rates; tackle late payments; boost R&D (credit to 13%); support self‑employed; new anti‑avoidance law and Digital Services Tax.
- Transport revolution: Northern Powerhouse Rail; Midlands Rail Hub; better buses, cycling, and roads; gigabit broadband nationwide by 2025. Towns Fund and Community Ownership Fund; wider English devolution.

Homes and Places
- At least a million more homes next Parliament; 300k/year by mid‑2020s; help first‑time buyers with long‑term fixed‑rate mortgages; protect renters (end no‑fault evictions); building safety; green, beautiful homes; protect and enhance the Green Belt.

Environment and Animal Welfare
- Net Zero 2050; 40GW offshore wind by 2030; EV charging network; carbon capture; tree planting and peatland restoration; tough action on plastics; Environment Bill; no fracking unless proven safe; stronger animal welfare laws.

Union and Global Britain
- Strengthen the Union; oppose a second Scottish referendum; support Northern Ireland and unfettered UK internal trade.
- Defence: exceed 2% NATO target; modernise forces; maintain Trident; Space Command; back veterans.
- Ambitious, fair free trade with the NHS off the table; Magnitsky sanctions; 0.7% aid; champion human rights, media freedom and girls’ education.

Only a Conservative majority will get Brexit done and unleash Britain’s full potential.
</text>
